meta.name: copywriting-first-touch
meta.description: Writes a high-converting first touch cold email — either as a standalone message or as the opening email of a sequence. Use this skill whenever the user wants to write the first email to a cold prospect, says "write me a first email", "draft a cold email", "write my first touch", "how do I open with this prospect", or asks for a single outreach email without prior context. Works for any industry, any product, any seniority level. Always produces one polished first-touch email with subject line, body, and a sequence bridge if needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出高转化率的首封冷邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要给潜在客户写第一封开发信
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write the first email to a cold prospect

howto.what: 当用户请求写一封冷邮件（首封）时，Claude 会先收集上下文（发送方、目标、场景等），然后运用 B2B 外联文案原则，写出包含主题行、正文和行动号召的邮件，并附上写作逻辑说明。
howto.when: 当用户说出“写封首封邮件”、“起草冷邮件”、“怎么开口”等，或要求写一封无前文背景的外联邮件时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一封给销售副总裁的首封邮件。
say.note: Claude 会先询问上下文后产出邮件。

say.text: 写一个冷邮件开头，目标 CIO，产品是数据分析平台。
say.note: Claude 会收集必要信息后生成。

say.text: 这个客户刚升职为CTO，怎么开第一封邮件？
say.note: Claude 会利用信号型开场。

howto.what_en: When asked to write a first-touch cold email, Claude gathers context (sender, target, scenario), applies B2B outbound copywriting principles, and produces an email with subject line, body, and CTA, plus an explanation of choices made.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "write me a first email", "draft a cold email", "write my first touch", "how do I open with this prospect", or asks for a single outreach email with no prior context.

say_en.text: Write me a first touch email for a VP of Sales.
say_en.note: Claude will ask context then generate.

say_en.text: Draft a cold email opener targeting a CIO for an analytics product.
say_en.note: Claude will gather info before writing.

say_en.text: How do I open with this prospect? He just got promoted to CTO.
